safety_note: Environmental exposure awareness reference only. Not medical diagnosis.
meaning_of_intake: Estimated INHALED PM2.5 mass over a day (concentration x inhalation rate x time). This is NOT an absorbed or deposited dose, NOT a clinical dose, and NOT a medical safety limit.
derivation_note: Demo OPERATIONAL_REFERENCE only. Approximated from the WHO 2021 24-hour PM2.5 guideline (~15 ug/m3) multiplied by a reference daily ventilation of ~15 m3/day (15 x 15 = 225 ug/day). Used solely to give the Airify demo a relatable daily budget bar. It is NOT a validated safe intake threshold and must not be presented as one.

user_groups.note: General adult operational reference. Practical, calm, non-medical wording.
Lower reference reflects higher inhaled intake per body weight. Preventive reference wording only, not a diagnosis.
Represents pregnancy / COPD / CVD / asthma reference triggers. No diagnosis, no treatment advice, no outcome claims.

assumptions.note: All assumptions are demo defaults for a relatable budget, not personalized clinical parameters.
